Variant-aware Exp55/56 imaging with frozen downstream scoring semantics.

``linear`` delegates directly to the retained paper scorer.  ``area`` replaces
only its fixed-size resize: spectrograms use two-dimensional adaptive local
means and recurrence plots pool the one-dimensional series before recomputing
their symmetric distance matrices.  The copied scoring closure below records
its immutable source module and SHA-256 for Exp451 provenance.

construction with the approved factor pair.

Pure Exp451 length conversion and adaptive local-mean pooling primitives.

The ``linear`` mode delegates directly to the frozen paper control. The only
new length rule is SciPy polyphase downsampling plus normalized-coordinate
PCHIP upsampling. These functions do not repair nonfinite source values.

Adaptive-average pooling runs MPS-first and falls back directly to PyTorch
CPU native adaptive-average pooling when MPS raises observed shape limitations.
No scalar-window loop fallback is used.

Label-free Exp451 completion verifier and frozen condition-manifest authority.

The module deliberately does not import a database or TEST-label accessor.  It
first checks every typed checkpoint envelope and only returns an authority that
the evaluation module may use after all four condition inventories are complete.
